verdict.rationale: Highnote explicitly documents issuing per-agent virtual cards with merchant category restrictions, velocity limits, and per-transaction caps enforced at authorization, plus auto-closing cards when a workflow ends, directly naming the agentic-commerce use case. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of a hard expiry field/date on agent cards (only workflow-end auto-closure) and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the feature working in production.
